results.evidence: [Part I Exclusion 1c]: Coverage... will not apply... for ride-sharing activity. [Part V Exclusion 14]: Coverage... will not apply to: 14. any covered auto while being used in connection with ride-sharing activity;
results.llm_answer: No, a breakdown is not covered if the insured uses their covered auto for a TNC (ride-sharing) activity, even if Roadside Assistance Coverage is purchased, because coverage is excluded for vehicles used in ride-sharing.
